description: Say it once. Keep it as a file. Nika turns the AI work you repeat into a readable workflow that stays yours: checked before it runs (schema, permits, cost floor), run with the model you choose, proven afterwards by a tamper-evident trace. Single Rust binary.
rules: Workflows are .nika files: a nine-key envelope opening with `nika: <kebab-id>` (the file's name, never `v1`) plus model, inputs, const, secrets, permits, run, tasks, outputs; four verbs (infer, exec, invoke, agent); everything callable is a tool under invoke
Run `nika check <file>` before handing a workflow to anyone — exit 0 is the bar, and the diagnostics name the exact fix
Models are provider/model form (ollama/llama3.2:3b local-first, mock/echo for a keyless preview that replaces the model, not tools or fetches); local models are unpriced, never call them free
Never invent nika:* builtins or providers — `nika catalog --tools` and `nika catalog` list the canonical sets
